edges.reason: onlyOwner gate compares the untrusted msg.sender with owner to authorize privileged calls.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner access-control check.
acceptOwnership authorizes on msg.sender == newOwner, a second access-control path.
newOwner state variable is the authorization target and is moved into owner.
msg.sender supplies the account burned by burn().
burn() accumulates and updates totalBurnt and supply state.
burn() leads to _burn which enforces the MinSupply subtraction check.
_totalSupply is decremented subject to the MinSupply floor.
MinSupply is the comparison bound guarding the supply subtraction.
The internal _burn function performs the checked supply/balance subtraction.
totalBurnt is read and written by the burn path.
Caller-supplied amount enters transfer().
Caller-supplied recipient enters transfer().
transfer() branches on block.timestamp against firstBlock to enforce the anti-bot limit.
Miner-influenceable block.timestamp drives the anti-bot max-buy window.
firstBlock is the stored timestamp bound of the anti-bot window.
firstTransfer flag initializes firstBlock on the first transfer.
transfer() writes firstBlock when firstTransfer is false.
transfer() calls randNumber() to derive the burn percentage.
randNumber hashes block.timestamp and block.difficulty, a miner-influenceable randomness source.
block.timestamp is an input to the pseudo-random burn amount.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random value.
randNumber return value is produced by the weak randomness operation.
randNumber() result is captured into _rand inside transfer().
Random percentage multiplies the amount to compute the burn amount.
User amount is scaled by the random percentage into _amountToBurn.
Computed burn amount is passed to _burn before the remainder transfer.
User-controlled amount determines the tokens burned in transfer().
transfer() invokes _burn on the sender when supply exceeds the bypass threshold.
After burning, the remainder is moved through _transfer.
_unBurntToken is forwarded to the internal transfer.
Remainder is derived by subtracting the burn amount from the user amount.
Burn amount feeds the remainder calculation.
_transfer mutates the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
_transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom calls the internal _transferFrom helper.
_transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in _allowances.
msg.sender is used as the spender for the allowance decrement.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
approve() routes through the internal _approve.
msg.sender receives the refunded msg.value in the receive() fallback.
receive() performs an external ETH send to the caller, enabling reentrant callbacks.
Refunded value flows into the external transfer call.
Caller address is the destination of the reentrancy-prone external send.
Constructor parameter initializes the owner state variable.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
New owner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
Name parameter is passed to the RedX constructor (overwritten by literal).
Symbol parameter is passed to the RedX constructor (overwritten by literal).
RedX constructor mints 1000 ether into _totalSupply.
RedX constructor credits the deployer balance.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter is only used to initialize the owner state variable inside the constructor core function.
Parameter is consumed directly by the transferOwnership core function to set newOwner.
Parameter belongs to the RedX constructor signature and has no independent dataflow.
Parameter belongs to the RedX constructor signature and has no independent dataflow.
Transfer recipient parameter only feeds the transfer core function and its internal _transfer call.
Transfer amount parameter only feeds the transfer core function including the anti-bot check and burn math.
Locally computed burn amount is consumed by the unsafe _burn invocation inside transfer().
Local remainder is consumed by the internal _transfer core function.
Local receives the value returned by the randNumber core function inside transfer().
Local copy of msg.value is used only by the unsafe external refund call in receive().
Return local is produced by the unsafe randomness operation in randNumber().
